body.x: HAPPY&GOOD is planning to present ‘Sha-bi, Se-bi’, multi-solutions for a bicycle, at CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show), the world largest IT technology held in Las Vegas, USA, from 9th January(Tue) to 12th January (Fri).

Supported by SeongNam Industry Promotion Agency, HAPPY&GOOD is able to present its product, ‘Sha-bi, Se-bi’. ‘Shabi, Se-bi’ is composed of IoT adapter installed on a bicycle, a device that locks, charges and detects thief when combined with the adapter, and operation solution that connects main server and App.

In the bicycle station, bike racks are placed to the right and left with the kiosk as the center. Users can bring their bikes to the station and easily slide the adapter onto their bike. The adapter on the rack will automatically sense, lock and even charge the bike automatically while parked.
Most stations are connected to the main server via the Internet so that it forms a set of the transport network and provides additional services by collecting real-time big data.

‘Shabi, Sebi’ is more than enough to meet the demand and expectation of users who wish to use and park bike conveniently. Compare to other existing systems, it is cost effective by 25% annually. In addition, it is possible to solve the problem of bikes left alone fundamentally and monitor and control all bicycles in real time.

SeongNam Industry Promotion Agency was established in 2001 to contribute to enhancing corporate management and reinforcing competitiveness through comprehensive and systematic supports for small and medium-sized enterprises as well as venture businesses. The agency plays roles in planning & researching for new business development; operating the business center and over-all supports including management/technology/information/foundation/labor force; discovering overseas market and supporting export business; carrying out investment and association of investment for corporate activities.

The world largest IT exhibition, CES, held every January by CTA (Consumer technology Association) is the place where you can feel the world trend in the electronics industry. AVING NEWS is the global news network which broadcasted news the most about the top 3 technology exhibitions: CES (Consumer Technology Show), MWC (Mobile World Congress), and IFA (International Funkausstellung Berlin) for the past 11 years and this time they will also send dispatch a special press to broadcast issues on global markets and introduce major corporates from Korea.
